contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [----]AVG [COS II PP] ; R/ ROMA ETER[--]

Silver coin. Denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), cf. mint of Alexandria issue of 194, RIC volume 4 part 1 no. 350g, following Sear volume 2 no. 6360, though obverse legend is odd; possibly contemporary copy; Reece period 10.. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [----]AVG [COS II PP]. Reverse description: Roma seated left with spear and shield, right arm outstretched. Reverse inscription: ROMA ETER[--]. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 2.57gms, die axis: 12
